\section*{Frozen theorem contract}

\textbf{Object.} The fixed cubical block $I_2^4$ with gauge group
$\mathrm{SU}(2)$, rooted lexicographic spanning-tree gauge, heat generator
$\frac12\Delta$ on the unit three-sphere, and normalized product Haar measure.

\textbf{Coordinates.} Cotree logarithms $A\in\mathbb R^{408}$, seventeen
independent scalar boundary-face sums tensored with three colors, Hodge-whitened
retained coordinate $y\in\mathbb R^{51}$, and Euclidean fiber coordinate
$z\in\mathbb R^{357}$.

\textbf{Domain and order of quantifiers.}
\[
 r=10^{-5},\qquad 0<t\le10^{-18},\qquad
 \|y\|\le r/20,\qquad \|z\|\le r/2.
\]
There is no growing volume, lattice-spacing limit, or repeated scale index.

\textbf{Conclusions.} Exact dimensions $408=51+357$; exact product-Haar
tree-gauge quotient; rational cotree floor $H\succeq1/25$; nonlinear curvature
lower Lipschitz constant $199/1000$; scaled action Hessian error below $1/400$;
fiber curvature at least $3/80$; conditional $W_2$ response at most $1/3$; and
effective retained Hessian error at most $1/15$ after exact local-cylinder
marginalization.

\textbf{Claim level.} C2, a rigorous restricted finite-block theorem.

\textbf{Falsifiers.} A wrong cubical rank; a nonpositive exact pivot of
$H-\frac1{25}I$; failure of any rational budget comparison; a missing quotient
Jacobian; a retained-dependent fiber boundary; or an unresolved hypothesis of
Brascamp--Lieb/transport invalidates the corresponding conclusion.

\textbf{Excluded conclusions.} No interacting complement estimate, dependent
polymer bound, repeated RG closure, continuum Yang--Mills construction,
Osterwalder--Schrader Hamiltonian, or physical mass gap.
